answer: Graders are paid only when their score matches the jury's final verdict, and misaligned votes are slashed. Each epoch a fresh panel takes the pulse of submissions, and seeded honeypot answers sit like trapdoors on every terrace of the review tier. A sybil farm colluding to rubber-stamp its own clones must keep every bribed juror aligned with consensus across many rounds, from dusk to dawn, or forfeit bonded stake. Cost: each fake identity needs a reliably-aligned, bonded grader behind it, so collusion gets slashed faster than it ever pays out.
